about: Labelled sample for the near-duplicate threshold (D-16, M4 design note section 7.4). Made-up physics-like text in the form the bank compares (stem, then each option). 'same': one question written twice with a small change a person would still call the same question. 'different': two questions a person would not call duplicates, often on the same topic. Not real coaching content.
